newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to stay weak following 109-08 break.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to stay weak following 109-08 break.

text.p: June gilt futures are likely to remain fragile on Friday following a selloff on Thursday that was accentuated by a break of 109-08, analysts said.
That level marked a cluster of chart ppints. The market had made a 109-08 high on April 11, then a 109-07 low on April 22.
"We just ran a few stops," said Jonathan York, futures broker at Mees Pierson Derivatives in London. He said 109-08 would now act as resistance, followed by 109-18,20.
He expected gilts to open fairly flat on Friday, with a downside target of around 108-20.
Gilts finished on Thursday at 109-01, down 15/32.

Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London, said the market could bounce in the short term off channel support at 108-25. She noted it had already touched a low of 108-26 in early trade.
By 0715 GMT, June gilts on LIFFE were at 108-29, down 4/32.
Chennel resistance was at 109-18 but that was unlikely to be tested, she said. Eventually she expected a break of the channel support. That would set up a test of April 11's 108-14 low.
"Obviously the bear trigger, the really big one, is 108-05, the low from April Fools Day." Miller said that level was also a retracement point on weekly continuation charts.
June short sterling was little moved, trading off 0.01 at 93.35.
